description: For home security install, this inspection checklist records device placement, privacy preferences, power and connectivity, communication path, permits, testing, and user training. Its supporting evidence includes device serials, zone map, signal tests, camera views, network results, alarm events, and monitoring confirmation.

subtitle: Home Security Install Inspection Checklist: home security system installation and activation using account, device placement, and device serials.
title: Home Security Install Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during home security system installation and activation when the home security install record must identify account, premises, zones, panel, sensors, cameras, network, monitoring plan, users, and emergency contacts. Complete the applicable handoff for zone verification, monitoring activation, user credential handoff, training acknowledgment, privacy settings, and support plan.
